title: Is Computed Tomography Associated With Survival in Adult Trauma Patients in an Urban Lower-middle Income Setting?
brief_summary: This study is aimed at assessing the survival benefit potentially associated with CT scans for trauma patients in an urban lower-middle income setting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presented alive
* Direct admission
* ≥ 15 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Burns
study_population: Adult trauma patients admitted to public university hospitals in urban India
